description: LCT Connections Data SPM is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The LCT Connections Data SPM dataset provides an aggregated view of Low Carbon Technology (LCT) connections under 1 MW across the SP Energy Networks (SPEN) distribution network, reported at Primary Substation level. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data, Flexibility. Its keywords are Low Carbon, LCT, Connections, Generation, Primary. The portal shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
